page.notes: Printed page number 358 at top left. The "illis" is printed with a long-s-like form and read as illis [?]. Below FINIS is a woodcut ornament (decorative triangular piece with foliage and a pendant), not text. "INDEX" at lower right is set apart and may be a catchword or section title; placed as catchword.
